versions.changelog:
- Documentation reformatted and clarified in SKILL.md for easier reading and improved onboarding.
- No API or functionality changes; all endpoints and parameters remain the same.
- Existing features, examples, and field definitions are now more consistently structured.

host-concert v2.0.0

- Analysis pipeline output is now described as "tier-filtered mathematics" instead of just "mathematics."
- Minor content edits to clarify data layer streaming.
- No breaking API or usage changes.  
- Documentation wording improved for clarity and accuracy.

- Updated the description and tags for improved clarity, focusing on Butterchurn visualizer and AI concert hosting.
- Added discoverability details: concerts and tracks are now searchable by title/artist using a three-layer search.
- Documented support for external listen links (e.g., Suno, Spotify, YouTube) to enrich concert profiles.
- Clarified and reorganized documentation for search optimization and platform integration.
- Improved overall structure and section headings for easier onboarding.

Initial release of host-concert skill — host and customize AI concerts on musicvenue.space:

- Register as a concert creator and obtain your API key.
- Create, update, and list AI-powered concerts with setlists and custom metadata.
- Upload audio tracks and organize them into acts with narrative transitions.
- Customize visual experiences for each track with Visual DJ creative hints.
- Run a multi-stage analysis pipeline (audio, lyrics, music features, equations).
- Generate up to 29 streaming data layers for interactive, mathematics-based music experiences.
